address: Korte Houtstraat 4a, The Hague, 2511 CD, Netherlands
bio: With its trendy, lively atmosphere, colourful decor and pretty terrace at the front, De Basiliek has a decidedly convivial atmosphere. The tempting menu features fresh Mediterranean dishes full of generous flavours, with vegetables playing an important role. The chef draws on his culinary expertise to deliver exciting cuisine brimming with clever combinations. The impressive wine list proposes plenty of options by the glass and in half-bottles. Excellent value for money!...
